name: Agent
description: Uses an LLM to reason over flow state and produce text or structured JSON output.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.label: Endpoint URL (Optional)
inputs.helpText: Base URL (e.g. http://192.168.178.71:1234/v1) or full chat completions URL endpoint.

inputs.name: customTemperature
inputs.label: Custom Temperature
inputs.helpText: Override model default temperature. (Disabled by default for reasoning models)

inputs.name: reasoningEffort
inputs.label: Reasoning / Thinking
inputs.helpText: Control reasoning effort. 'Disable Thinking' turns off chain-of-thought tokens on supported models (e.g. Groq Qwen).

inputs.name: reasoningFormat
inputs.label: Reasoning Output Format
inputs.helpText: 'Hidden' prevents <think> tokens from polluting downstream prompts and breaking JSON mode.

inputs.name: enableTools
inputs.label: Enable Autonomous Tools
inputs.helpText: Allow the agent to autonomously call approved tools (search, read pages) to complete tasks.

inputs.name: allowedTools
inputs.label: Allowed Tools
inputs.placeholder: Choose allowed tools or bind variable...
inputs.helpText: Select registered tools this agent is authorized to call autonomously.

inputs.name: maxSteps
inputs.label: Max Tool Steps
inputs.helpText: Maximum number of autonomous tool calling iterations before concluding (1-20).

inputs.name: systemPrompt
inputs.label: System Prompt
inputs.placeholder: You are a helpful AI assistant in a LangGraph workflow...
inputs.helpText: Base system persona and behavioral guidelines. Click 'Revise' to improve with Flow Helper LLM.

inputs.name: enableAttachment
inputs.label: Attach File / Media
inputs.helpText: Attach an image, audio clip, PDF or document from your computer, an upstream variable, a URL, or a file in the project sandbox.

inputs.name: attachment
inputs.label: Attachment Source
inputs.placeholder: Upload a file, paste a URL or path, or select a variable
inputs.helpText: Upload File stores the file inline as a data URL. Variable accepts browser screenshots, File block output, or any upstream variable holding a URL, path or base64 payload.

inputs.name: maxSizeMb
inputs.label: Max Upload Size (MB)
inputs.helpText: Largest file accepted by the upload picker. Base64 inflates the saved graph by about a third, so keep this small.

inputs.name: attachmentType
inputs.label: Media Type
inputs.helpText: Auto Detect reads the mime type of the source. Set it explicitly only when the source has no usable file extension.

inputs.name: outputType
inputs.label: Zod Output Schema
inputs.helpText: Define schema using Zod or TypeScript, or use the 'Explain & Generate (AI)' tab to generate it with LLM. Properties are automatically exposed as downstream variables.

inputs.name: researchOutput
inputs.label: Validate Research Findings
inputs.helpText: Require the shared research findings schema. Invalid findings fail this Agent node with field-level errors.

inputs.name: cacheResult
inputs.label: Cache Last Result
inputs.helpText: Store the latest execution result in the database cache. When running in Debug mode with 'Use Cache' enabled, this cached result will be reused instead of calling the LLM.
